## Summary of the last run

The page is logically sound. The main theorems (Alexandroff's G_delta theorem and its converse) are proved correctly, hypotheses are verified, and citations match their targets. The supplement's claim that ℚ is a continuous image of ℕ is correct (ℚ is countable hence analytic, and every nonempty analytic set is a continuous image of ℕ^ℕ), so it is a valid example of failure of preservation under continuous images.
